item.title: Utah’s David Huntsman carries Olympic torch in rain‑soaked Milan suburb, highlights mental health ahead of 2034 Games
item.description: Rainfall didn’t stop Utah’s David Huntsman from carrying the Olympic flame Tuesday morning as the torch continued its journey toward Milan.

item.title: What to know about the disappearance of Nancy Guthrie, mother of ‘Today’ show’s Savannah Guthrie
item.description: Authorities are looking for the 84-year-old mother of “Today” show host Savannah Guthrie after they said she was taken from her Arizona home against her will last weekend.

item.title: Man who tried to shoot Trump at a Florida golf course gets life in prison
item.description: Federal prosecutors are asking that a man convicted of trying to assassinate President Donald Trump be sentenced to life in prison.

item.title: Deadly police shooting ensues in Tooele during overnight shooting investigation
item.description: A man was shot multiple times at a gas station in Tooele on Tuesday night, and police said they were still searching for anyone connected.

item.title: Trump’s border czar pulling 700 immigration officers out of Minnesota immediately
item.description: President Donald Trump's border czar says the number of immigration enforcement officers in Minnesota is being cut after state and local officials agreed to cooperate by turning over arrested immigrants.

item.title: Health benefits of tart cherries and how to grow the fruit in Utah
item.description: The KSL Greenhouse Show went over the benefits of eating tart cherries and how to grow the fruit in Utah.

item.title: Gorilla at Utah’s Hogle Zoo is expecting a baby
item.description: A 38-year-old gorilla at Utah's Hogle Zoo is expected to give birth sometime in March.

item.title: What’s up with the exploding trees? The KSL Greenhouse Show explains winter tree damage
item.description: The KSL Greenhouse Show explained why winter damage happens to trees and why sometimes, extremely low temperatures cause exploding trees.

item.title: New, stronger fentanyl variant discovered in Utah
item.description: The FBI says a more potent type of fentanyl has been found in Utah, where fentanyl seizures are only increasing each year.

item.title: US wants to create a critical minerals trading bloc with its allies to counter China
item.description: The Trump administration says it wants to create a critical minerals trading bloc with its allies and partners. It would use tariffs to maintain minimum prices and defend against China's stranglehold.
